news.title: China’s Weaponization of Dual-Use Research Vessels for Undersea Data Dominance
news.summary_en: Analysis of 223 vessels finds that Chinese research ships spend an unusually large share of time near subsea infrastructure on the high seas. The findings call for stronger allied monitoring, coordinated patrols, and faster cable repair.

news.title: Learning Without Bleeding: China’s Lessons from the Russia-Ukraine Drone War
news.summary_en: China is using the Russia-Ukraine drone war as a military laboratory. Lilly Min-Chen Lee and Kateryna Bondar trace how quickly Chinese analysts identify battlefield innovations and how the PLA translates the lessons into training, procurement, hardware, and force structure.

news.title: The Postwar Threat to Gulf Energy Infrastructure
